sentences.text: The gold loan FAQ does not state any pre-payment charge for gold loans; it only says a gold loan is a loan against pledged gold ornaments and that the tenure is up to 12 months.
The bank’s retail loan policy says foreclosure charges of 2% plus GST on the principal outstanding are levied on all term loans pre-closed by the borrower.
The evidence does not show that this term-loan charge is the rule stated in the gold loan FAQ, so the FAQ itself does not provide a gold-loan-specific pre-payment charge.

missing.searched: Gold Loan FAQ; bank retail loan policy; RBI/UCB pre-payment charge directions
